pageDescription: Install apps with WinGet, manage Windows/driver/app updates, apply reversible tweaks, and configure Windows features — inspired by WinUtil.

install.heading: Install
install.description: Use WinGet to install, upgrade, or uninstall popular applications without hunting for download links.
install.wingetMissingHint: Install App Installer from the Microsoft Store to use this tab.
install.selectCategory: Select or clear all apps in this category
install.toastNothingSelected: Select one or more apps first

tweaks.heading: Tweaks
tweaks.description: Apply reversible Windows privacy and performance tweaks. Running selected tweaks creates a System Restore Point before changes are made.
tweaks.windowsOnly: Tweaks are available on Windows only
tweaks.essentialDescription: Recommended privacy defaults for most Windows installs.
tweaks.advancedDescription: Deeper system policy and service changes for users who understand the tradeoffs.
tweaks.advancedCaution: CAUTION: Advanced tweaks can change Windows services, scheduled tasks, or AI features. Review each selected item before running.
tweaks.toastNothingSelected: Select one or more tweaks first
tweaks.toastImportInvalid: Invalid or empty tweak selection file
tweaks.powerPlansDescription: Switch between Windows Balanced mode and Ultimate Performance.
tweaks.powerPlanUnavailable: Power plans are unavailable on this system
tweaks.shutUpDescription: Open O&O ShutUp10++ if it is installed, or open the official download page.

config.heading: Config
config.description: Enable Windows optional features, open legacy panels, configure OpenSSH, and run safe repair helpers.
config.windowsOnlyDescription: Config tools require Windows optional feature, service, and Control Panel APIs.
config.featuresDescription: Check current feature state, enable or disable selected optional features, and revert boot/task changes.
config.rebootRequired: A reboot may be required before Windows finishes applying this change.
config.toastNothingSelected: Select one or more features first
config.panelsDescription: Open classic Control Panel surfaces that are still useful for advanced configuration.
config.openSshUnavailable: OpenSSH Server metadata is unavailable on this system.
config.fixesDescription: Run focused repair commands. Destructive resets ask for confirmation first.
config.fixConfirm: Run {{name}}? This can reset system networking or service state and may interrupt connectivity.

updates.heading: Updates
updates.description: Check and install Windows, driver, and application updates. Pause Windows Update when you need a quiet window, and run focused repair helpers when things get stuck.
updates.windowsOnlyDescription: Utility Updates require Windows Update, driver, and package-manager APIs.
updates.rebootRequired: A reboot may be required before Windows finishes applying this change.
updates.toastNothingSelected: Select one or more items first

windowsUpdate.title: Windows Update
windowsUpdate.description: Check for OS updates, install pending packages, pause or resume updates, and open Windows Update settings.
windowsUpdate.installConfirm: Install all pending Windows updates now? This may take a while and can require a reboot.

drivers.title: Driver updates
drivers.description: Scan Windows Update for driver packages and install the ones you select.
drivers.updatesDisabledTitle: Driver updates are turned off in Windows
drivers.updatesDisabledText: Windows is set to exclude drivers from Windows Update, so Bulwrk did not check for driver updates. You can re-enable them in Windows device installation settings or Group Policy.
drivers.toastRebootRequired: A reboot is required to finish installing drivers

apps.title: App updates
apps.description: Find outdated apps via your package managers and update selected packages, or upgrade everything WinGet knows about.
apps.upgradeAllConfirm: Upgrade all outdated WinGet packages? This can take several minutes.
apps.noUpdates: All scanned apps are up to date.

helpers.title: Helpers
helpers.description: Restart Windows Update services or repair WinGet when package installs get stuck.
helpers.resetWuServicesDescription: Stop and restart Windows Update-related services without wiping the SoftwareDistribution cache.
helpers.resetWuServicesConfirm: Restart Windows Update services? Active downloads may be interrupted.
helpers.wingetRepairDescription: Reset WinGet sources and try to restore a healthy package-manager configuration.
